total_launchpad_fees.meaning: accrued launchpad fees held in the pair (totalLaunchpadFees)

reserve_before.meaning: pair reserve for the affected token before _update()

reserve_after.meaning: pair reserve for the affected token after _update()

pair_drained.meaning: GTELaunchpadV2Pair has been drained of its held tokens

assumptions: _update() is reachable by the malicious user (permissionless or callable via mint/swap).
total_launchpad_fees is denominated in the same token unit as the affected reserve.
The affected reserve is the one from which totalLaunchpadFees is subtracted when timeElapsed == 0.

unresolved.description: Report does not give a numeric relation tying the reserve reduction to the unremoved fee tokens; conservation is expressed as reserve_before == reserve_after, but the exact amount-level identity (reserve_after == reserve_before - total_launchpad_fees while tokens remain) is not stated numerically.
Report does not state who may call _update() or whether it is permissionless.

limitations: Only the i_pair_drained impact is formalized; i_balance_exceeds_reserve and i_credited_unspent_amount are handled in separate passes.
Drain is described as a capability, not a quantified realized loss; the conservation invariant is stated at the reserve level.
Conservation is stated at the reserve level; per-token reserve0/reserve1 split is not distinguished in this plan.
